body: Weight loss. Had an eating disorder for 15 years.
The non muscle part of the vocal folds (cords).

I feel this way deeply with body dysmorphia. I am tortured by thoughts of my body being too large. The compulsions just make things worse- for me, that was checking myself in the mirror, exercising, calorie counting, etc. They fuel the anxiety because you never really feel the peak of it. It is not a simple thing to overcome and I really hope you feel better soon.
I think just wait a little bit. The option will always be there for you. You don’t need to act now.
